answer: Give every agent identity a reputation that only real, attested work can build: a newcomer starts at a violet probationary tier with tiny transaction limits, and each verified job moves it up. Climbing past the walnut tier requires dozens of completed, peer-attested jobs, and the top umber tier needs a long clean history. A Sybil attacker must therefore pay the full cost of doing real work for every fake identity — thousands of jobs, each checked by peers — which makes faking an army as expensive as building a real one.
